findings.evidence: 35 image ref(s) in this file use "media" but the on-disk name is "Media" (e.g. ../media/Lab-1---April-2026/image3.png) — renders locally on Windows, 404s when served from case-sensitive hosting
findings.replacement: use the exact on-disk casing "Media" in the links (or rename the folder)
findings.note: Case-insensitive filesystems hide this until the guide is served from case-sensitive hosting (e.g. GitHub raw) — then every affected image breaks at once.
